title: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
summary: Count the groups of vertices that can reach one another through undirected edges.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–2000 vertices labeled 0 through n−1. There are 1–5000 distinct undirected edges without self-loops.

statement: Count the groups of vertices that can reach one another through undirected edges. Count isolated vertices as groups of one.

examples.explanation: Only vertices 1 and 4 share a group.

constraints: 1–2000 vertices labeled 0 through n−1. There are 1–5000 distinct undirected edges without self-loops.
hints: Conceptual: An isolated vertex is a component on its own.
Directional: Start one search per unvisited vertex, or merge endpoints with Union-Find.
Implementation: With Union-Find, start the count at n and subtract only when an edge merges two separate sets.
complexityAnalysis: O(V + E) time and space with traversal, or O(V + E α(V)) time and O(V) space with Union-Find.
